Current queue review,20October2026 (bd-01M5E33RPWBT8NAGKCKJMMN6FN)

Completeness: not_accepted.
Assessment: Separate unfamiliar-file acceptance is required; fixed project controls do not establish ordinary-file usability.
Staleness: S1/U2 prerequisites remain correct.
Remaining / next action: After S1/U2 landing, independent unfamiliar synthetic/licensed source plus two recalls, one failure, three weights/readers and exact Atlas replay.
Audit: docs/refactor/evidence/queue-review-20261020/README.md. This planning review does not grant publication, study-read or integration authority.

--- Preserved prior scope, acceptance and history ---

Outcome: someone other than the implementer can obtain useful checked output from unfamiliar authorized study files using the published instructions, without editing Scala or receiving undocumented developer intervention.

Acceptance:
1. An independent reviewer supplies an eligible source plus at least two recalls outside the fixed Anna/Sherlock controls. Prefer independently authored synthetic or licensed public material; any repository text must pass its own admission header/review. Actual participant material requires the existing recorded basis and approved host; do not acquire it merely to complete this test.
2. From a clean installation, the reviewer records each command, setup step and intervention. Produce paired mappings and weights 0/1,1/2,1/1; the independent readers verify hashes, joins, unit/word accounting and measure kinds. Add one deliberate failed observation and retain its denominator/status. Success requires zero undocumented setup steps after the documented clean installation.
3. Exercise the approved local admission, missing-authority refusal, byte-identical resume, changed-input refusal and overwrite refusal. For supplied timing, preserve units/origin/coverage; missing timing remains unavailable. No inference of physical scanner synchronization or word-level precision.
4. Import the same admitted output into the exact pinned StoryAtlas consumer when claiming the workspace route; verify numeric agreement, unavailable values and saved-state replay. Bind producer/consumer SHAs, default pin versus override and fixture digests. Follow AGENTS browser ownership rules and close owned automation.
5. Repair discovered guide/integration defects and rerun only affected witnesses. Retain the independent transcript and exact artifact receipt; report this as usability/engineering evidence, not mapping accuracy.

Next action after S1/U2: build the final candidate bundle and hand the documented task to one independent reviewer. Native N1 may proceed in parallel; it remains required for unrestricted stable Native delivery, not for this JVM usability experiment.

Evidence and completion: keep exact baseline/candidate SHA, input and artifact hashes, literal commands and actual exits, passed/failed/skipped totals, initial adverse evidence, and independent exact-SHA review. Runtime changes use tools/reference-scope.sh in a clean standalone clone, fatal warnings, all affected platforms and the pinned StoryAtlas consumer where consumed; formatting runs last. Documentation/tracker-only changes use a format/integrity check and cold review (T2). One primary writer, one helper and one heavy gate at a time. Claim only the slice and reserve its narrow paths. No percentage-complete or efficacy claim follows from ticket/test counts.
